strings.en: What!? What's going on!? Everyone, stop!
Honestly, you tell everyone not to be reckless, and then you pull this.
You'd have done this even if we left you alone.
It's totally obvious.
But this... how's it gonna turn out?
We're doing it to make it turn out. Hey, Shinobu! You're good, right!?
Who knows!
Quit whining! Full power!
Fall back! Don't come any closer!!
With everyone this fired up... no chance, Captain.
Excellen, you too!?
Well, if my darling says he's doing it...
...I told you to stop calling me that.
Ya got married while I wasn't lookin'! So when's the baby comin'?
Juzo! Your arm slipped a little! Hold it steady!
That's right! ...We might not last.
Don't give up! Give up... and it ends right there...!
Raideen... I'm trusting in your power!
Stop it! You don't have to go along with this!
What... What is happening!?
Heh, the Captain's right. You've all lost it.
Then go ahead and Open Get out of here, Hayato.
I'd like to, but...
split up now and the Get Machines would burn up from the friction.
I'll see it through.
You're not honest, Hayato. ...All right, trust in Getter's power!
We can't lose to Getter Robo, Uchuta! Keiko!
I'm trying! But it's crazy hot. The joints might melt!
Hey! Don't say scary stuff like that!
No! You'll just self-destruct from friction heat and overload!
Like Super Alloy Z melts that easy! ...Ow, hot!
The glass is getting hot!
Koji! Can you hold out!?
You're in no position to worry about me, Tetsuya!
Don't push yourselves, you two!
If I didn't mean to push it, I wouldn't be here, Daisuke!
Rain! You're not a Fighter! Get back while you can!
I'm fine!
...Domon's Shining Gundam will protect me!
Heh... That's right. We are one in body and soul!
One measly rock like this is nothing!
Tch, lovey-dovey and carefree on top of it.
In tennis, zero-zero is... love-all... heh heh heh.
Ugh, it's so hot. Isn't the AC working?
Put a little more spirit into it, guys...
Not a chance! Gekigan Barrier, full power!!
Ngh... Even modified for space... this is...
The outside temperature... I don't even want to look.
Lieutenant Amada, Lieutenant Mackenzie, fall back!
Those units can't...!
...Not yet!
...The Alex was built for Captain Amuro, too.
...This is nothing...!
Chris! Don't push it!
Even with Daitarn's size...
covering this many units is tough. ...Ngh.
That's enough! Everyone, stop!
In the end... sooner or later, only this kind of sorrow will spread...
and crush the Earth.
So mankind must pass judgment on itself with its own hands,
and atone to nature, and to the Earth!
Amuro... why can't you understand this...!!
If it falls like this...! Dangaioh... protect everyone...
To all those born of fire and water, of heaven and earth...!
Heaven and earth, fire and water, grant us your last strength...!
Get away! The Gundam's power is...!
Th-This is... the psycoframe resonating...
Is it overloading from so much human will focused at once!?
Light... from Amuro's Gundam!? This is... like what happened to me!?
This feeling...
Like when we used the bio-sensor to find the way out of that dimension...!?
It's gathering... This is... aura light...!?
Aura light... from everyone.
Just like that time. Everyone's feelings... are becoming power...!
What...? I feel no fear... Instead, it's warm... reassuring, even...
Kyosuke!
Yes, this power... will change the galaxy...!
...I get it, this is the power of life! It'll keep the universe going...!
I see...! But it's humans with this very warmth who'd destroy even Earth!
Understand that, Amuro!!
I do understand! That's why!
We have to show the world the light of the human heart, don't we!
Axis is...!?
Did it work...!? What about Joe...!?
...Captain! Axis has changed course...!
It's moving away from Earth!
What about Akito... and everyone...!?
Hey, Ruri, they're okay, right!? Right!?
...I don't know. But... I believe in them.
All units, respond! Amuro!
...This is Amuro Ray. Returning to base.
Amuro...!?
Captain! What about the others...?
...Dead and missing... both zero.
The space fortress Axis...
That asteroid, once a Zeon fortress,
was sent hurtling toward Earth by Char Aznable.
But it never fell.
The power of united human hearts gathered in the psycoframes as light,
forming a Mobius ring around Earth...
And that Mobius ring... was the very power to change the universe.
